_comment: Topic pack definitions. Every pack includes brand-profile (foundation) and scheduling-and-queue (the publishing bridge, which pulls in the WoopSocial guide); packs that produce written or spoken content also include voice-builder. Overlap between packs is intentional — each pack is a complete kit for its use case. Relevant tools/integrations guides are embedded automatically at build time. Skills must match directory names under skills/.

packs.title: Social Media Starter Kit

packs.tagline: Everything you need your first week
